title: The Rental Store
kicker: My library, back in the aisles
tagline: A walk through the video store, with my own library on the shelves.
what: I put my Jellyfin library inside Halcyon Video’s walkable rental store. I built the parts that make it work for my family and friends: their usual login, private service keys and a catalog that does not make them wait at the door.
built: Replaced the server picker with a membership-card login
Kept catalog and game-service keys behind a server proxy
Cached each person’s catalog for their next visit
Moved actor lookups behind the opening so the store appears first

remix.changed: I built the home deployment, membership login, private proxy, catalog cache and faster opening.

making.problem: I wanted picking a movie to feel like a walk through a rental store, not another long list.
how: Halcyon Video supplies the walkable store. My membership-card login uses the Jellyfin accounts people already have.
A server proxy keeps service keys out of public browser code. Each person’s catalog is cached for the next visit.
The store opens before actor details finish loading; those arrive in the background.

broke.title: Back in the aisles
broke.body: A cached visit opened in about nine seconds, with the catalog restored in a quarter of a second. Moving cast lookups out of the opening cut the Movies boot page from 48.3 seconds to 4.2.

proof.caption: The real store renderer, stocked with its built-in demo library.

credits: Membership login, proxy, cache and opening fixes: me
